prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "Use well-lit front-facing photos for the best custom desktop pet generation results.", "Make sure pet eyes and face are clearly visible!"]
1: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet walks across your screen, responds to clicks, and sits on active windows.", "Got It, Continue", "Your Pet Is Ready!", "Your desktop companion is active. Enjoy having your new pet alongside your daily work."]
2: ["Bind Your Pet to Your Account", "Sign in to ensure your customized pet status and progress are preserved across logins and app updates.", "Signing in links your pet safely to your primary profile."]
3: ["Choose a Ready-to-Adopt Pet", "Select one of our pre-crafted desktop pets to get started instantly.", "Adopt Selected Pet", "Select Your Adoption Style", "Create a custom pet from photos or choose an instant pre-made companion."]
4: ["Generating Your Desktop Pet Overlay", "We are preparing your pet graphics and calibrating desktop window interactions.", "Initializing pet animations", "Configuring desktop screen overlay permissions"]
5: ["Compatible with Windows 10/11 & macOS. Pet overlay runs seamlessly alongside open windows."]
6: ["Protect Your Pet with Cloud Sync", "Connect your account now so your pet companion stays safely backed up whenever you sign back in."]
7: ["Includes Free Starter Toy & Snack Bundle"]
8: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Pet Workspace", "Right-click your pet on screen at any time to open quick actions, change behaviors, or hide companion."]
9: ["If pet does not appear on your screen when ready, check your taskbar or app permissions."]
